exposure: Crack cocaine use vs. other drugs
Type of narcotic substance used by mother
cohort: 100 neonates born to drug-addicted mothers during the first six months of 2008.
finding: 60% of neonates born to drug-addicted mothers showed signs of NAS, with the most prevalent signs being increased muscle tonicity, irritability, and increased moro reflex, and neonates born to crack cocaine users were significantly more likely to develop NAS compared to other drugs.
